purpose: 阶段 1/2 缩高 cube smoke 的冻结输入：25 个真实 40 um 层 -> 5 个 200 um 激活 slab，验证真实层到 slab 的映射、显式 recoat、0/90 旋转、时间/能量台账，以及 runner 的激活与温度映射合同。smoke 几何（4 x 4 mm 足印、8 x 8 x 1.6 mm 基板）只用于机制验证，不承载结果；生产几何字段保持 Balbaa 原值。

layer_schedule.activation_rule: activate a 200 um slab when its first contained 40 um physical-layer scan starts

thermal_mechanical.release_rule: substrate cells cut (stiffness and locked-in stress removed) + 3-point rigid-body anchors on printed nodes; bottom Dirichlet temperature held at the preheat value through cooldown (Balbaa: 600 s cooling, then model-change removal of the substrate)

runner.layer_activation_note: centroid, NOT intersection: jax_fem_am.mesh.model.cells_intersect_distance_band is boundary-INCLUSIVE, so with slab faces exactly on cell faces the band [0, k*lt] also captures the touching cells of slab k+1 (observed 2026-08-26: printed_cells 13600 = substrate 12800 + TWO slabs on the very first scan row). The centroid rule ceil(z_c/lt) maps slab k cells to layer id k unambiguously (AM-Bench L0 rev-4 uses the same rule).
runner.heat_source_note: legacy Gaussian x exponential source read as a lumped-slab deposition (D-V2-10). In-plane radius = one 200 um cell (sigma 100 um; vertex-lattice ripple 2*exp(-2*pi^2*(sigma/h)^2) = 1.4 % per axis, measured +-1.4 % track to track; edge tracks lose ~15 %). DEPTH: with --thermal-mass-lumping the HEX8 source is collocated at cell VERTICES (jax_fem_am/mesh/quadrature.py recomputes physical_quad_points), so the exponential profile is sampled at depth 0 (slab top) and depth 200 um (slab bottom, counted again by the substrate cell below); with d = 100 um / cutoff = 200 um that trapezoid over-integrates the band by (1 + 2 e^-2)/2 / (1 - e^-2) = 1.4696 (measured 1.447-1.47 on 2026-08-26). The contract therefore cuts the band at 199 um (only the slab-top samples remain inside) and sets d so that the discrete band integral under the vertex rule is exactly 1: d(1 - exp(-cutoff/d)) = h/2 -> d = 125.935 um (the same pair gives 1.0007 under 2-point Gauss sampling). This is a quadrature-consistency choice, not a fit to any measurement; the capture fraction is still MEASURED by the stage-2 capture trial.

consolidation.note: consolidation-on-activation with melt detection OFF: solidus = liquidus = 10000 K is a sentinel above any reachable temperature (peaks ~1.7-2.0e3 K on 200 um cells), so an activated slab is solid immediately and stays solid; T_ref := 1273.15 K once at activation (Balbaa: stress model initial temperature 1000 C, above which thermal stress is negligible). LESSON 2026-08-26: 'liquidus == solidus' at the physical 1563 K does NOT disable melt detection -- the L0 convention only looked that way because L0 peaks stayed below it. With peaks above 1563 K the v06 lifecycle raised a reference-reset event on almost every scan step (cells entering/leaving the melted state), each event FORCING a mechanics solve (runner.install_mechanics_event_wrapper): measured 2.27 s/step, i.e. ~10 h for the smoke and eqp/T_ref erased on every re-scan of a slab. Balbaa's cube stress model has no annealing/remelt reset (one stress-free reference, plastic strain accumulates through every re-heating), so the sentinel is the parity reading; the lifecycle-reset alternative is recorded in CUBE-SMOKE.md as measured, not adopted.
